select_field.description: Select named record columns in order, incrementally by Arrow batch. Params: columnNames (comma-separated string).

columnNames.description: columnNames parameter. Select named record columns in order, incrementally by Arrow batch. Params: columnNames (comma-separated string).

drop_field.description: Remove record columns incrementally. Params: columnNames (comma-separated string); absent names ignored.

columnNames.description: columnNames parameter. Remove record columns incrementally. Params: columnNames (comma-separated string); absent names ignored.

convert_schema.description: Rename columns; does not cast data types. Params: schema, e.g. station_id->station,temperature->air_c.

schema.description: schema parameter. Rename columns; does not cast data types. Params: schema, e.g. station_id->station,temperature->air_c.

distinct.description: Deduplicate records across Arrow batches; retains the first row per key. Params: optional columnNames; empty means all columns. Key-state limit: 128 MiB.

columnNames.description: columnNames parameter. Deduplicate records across Arrow batches; retains the first row per key. Params: optional columnNames; empty means all columns. Key-state limit: 128 MiB.

add_uuid_stop.description: Prepend a distinct 32-character hexadecimal UUID per row. Params: column (new column name).

column.description: column parameter. Prepend a distinct 32-character hexadecimal UUID per row. Params: column (new column name).

filter.description: Filter Arrow batches by a SQLite SQL predicate (not Spark SQL). Params: condition, e.g. quality = 0 AND temperature >= 12. Scalar columns only.

condition.description: SQLite SQL predicate applied to each record batch, e.g. quality = 0.

fork.description: Duplicate each input batch to two fixed ports, left and right. No params. Adaptation: explicit ports replace PiFlow dynamic outports.

column_check.description: Validate full ordered column names against a reference and return left input. Params: none. Inputs: left, right. Left-input buffering limit: 128 MiB. Does not check physical units.

consistency_check.description: Left-join reference keys; prepend flagField=0 for matches, 1 otherwise. Params: flagField, correlationColumn (comma-separated). Duplicate reference keys retain join multiplicity. 128 MiB input limit each.

flagField.description: flagField parameter. Left-join reference keys; prepend flagField=0 for matches, 1 otherwise. Params: flagField, correlationColumn (comma-separated). Duplicate reference keys retain join multiplicity. 128 MiB input limit each.

correlationColumn.description: correlationColumn parameter. Left-join reference keys; prepend flagField=0 for matches, 1 otherwise. Params: flagField, correlationColumn (comma-separated). Duplicate reference keys retain join multiplicity. 128 MiB input limit each.

merge.description: Stream left records followed by right records, retaining duplicates. Identical ordered schemas required. No params. Fixed ports replace dynamic inports.

subtract.description: EXCEPT DISTINCT over whole rows: return unique left rows absent from right. Nulls compare equal for this set operation. No params. 128 MiB input limit each.

join.description: Key-based inner/left/right/full_outer record join. Params: joinMode, correlationColumn. Colliding right non-key columns receive _right suffix. 128 MiB per input.

joinMode.description: Join semantics: inner, left, right, or full_outer.

add_day_id.description: Spark EcoFlow: sort year/month/day/hour; add id and day_id. Params: partitionNum string. Inputs materialized, max 128 MiB / one million rows.

partitionNum.description: partitionNum parameter. Spark EcoFlow: sort year/month/day/hour; add id and day_id. Params: partitionNum string. Inputs materialized, max 128 MiB / one million rows.

route.description: Route by SQLite condition. Outputs: result (all rows), matched, unmatched (including SQL null predicates). Fixed ports replace dynamic PiFlow routing.

condition.description: condition parameter. Route by SQLite condition. Outputs: result (all rows), matched, unmatched (including SQL null predicates). Fixed ports replace dynamic PiFlow routing.

execute_sql_stop.description: Read-only SQLite SQL over a named input relation (not Spark SQL). Params: sql, viewName. Scalar inputs, max 128 MiB. Output types inferred; empty computed columns have null type.

params.sql: SELECT station_id,AVG(temperature) AS mean_c FROM observations GROUP BY station_id

viewName.description: Relation name used to expose the input to the query.

csv_save.description: Serialize record batches as a UTF-8 CSV byte stream. Params: header (bool, default true), delimiter (one character, default comma). No destination path or file side effect.

header.description: Include a header row in the output.

csv_parser.description: Stream UTF-8 CSV bytes to Arrow string columns. Params: header (bool, default true), delimiter (one character), schema (names for headerless input). No csvPath; quoted fields supported. No type inference.

header.description: Treat the first CSV row as column names.

schema.description: Comma-separated column names for headerless CSV.

csv_string_parser.description: Parse headerless UTF-8 CSV text bytes to string records. Params: delimiter, schema; absent schema generates _0, _1, etc. Input stream replaces PiFlow string property.

delimiter.description: delimiter parameter. Parse headerless UTF-8 CSV text bytes to string records. Params: delimiter, schema; absent schema generates _0, _1, etc. Input stream replaces PiFlow string property.

schema.description: schema parameter. Parse headerless UTF-8 CSV text bytes to string records. Params: delimiter, schema; absent schema generates _0, _1, etc. Input stream replaces PiFlow string property.
